"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT: WORLD-CLASS BATTLE ROYALE GAME

1. GAME TITLE

Create a professional 3D mobile battle royale game called BATTLE WORLD: ELITE SURVIVAL.

The game must be an original, high-quality, action-packed survival shooter inspired by the battle royale genre of games like Free Fire. Do not copy copyrighted game assets, maps, characters, or logos. Create original characters, weapons, environments, and branding.

2. PLATFORM AND GAME ENGINE

- Build the game primarily for Android mobile phones.
- Use a real-time 3D game engine.
- Optimize the graphics and performance for low-end, medium-range, and high-end Android devices.
- Provide touch controls and customizable button layouts.
- Create a working, playable game rather than just a visual demonstration.
- Include all necessary game files, scripts, scenes, assets, and configuration.
- Provide a method to build and export an installable Android APK.
- If you cannot create the entire game in one generation, build it in organized, working stages without pretending unfinished features are complete.

3. MAIN GAME MODE

Create an online multiplayer battle royale game.

- Support up to 50 real players per match when server capacity permits.
- If 50 players are not possible in the first version, make the player count configurable and start with a smaller working match.
- Players enter a large island and fight to survive.
- Players can explore, collect weapons, find ammunition, collect protective equipment, and use medical supplies.
- The playable zone gradually shrinks, forcing players toward the center.
- Players outside the safe zone receive damage.
- The last surviving player or team wins.
- Add solo, duo, and squad modes.
- Include an optional practice mode with computer-controlled enemies.
- Add a spectator mode for eliminated players where appropriate.
- Include a proper matchmaking system and dedicated authoritative servers for fair online play.

4. OPEN-WORLD MAP

Create a detailed, original 3D island with different locations, including:

- A modern city with tall buildings.
- Abandoned military bases.
- Villages and houses.
- Forests, hills, and mountains.
- Rivers, lakes, and bridges.
- An industrial area.
- An airport and hangars.
- A harbor and beach.
- Hidden loot locations.
- Underground bunkers.
- Watchtowers and sniper positions.

Allow players to run, walk, crouch, jump, climb where supported, swim where appropriate, and drive vehicles.

Add a minimap, a full map, a compass, and visible safe-zone boundaries.

5. CHARACTERS

Create a collection of original, high-quality 3D characters.

Include:

- Character selection.
- Different outfits and hairstyles.
- Character animations.
- Running, jumping, crouching, aiming, shooting, reloading, and victory animations.
- Character customization.
- Unlockable skins and cosmetic rewards.
- A player profile showing level, experience, victories, eliminations, and statistics.

Cosmetic items must not unfairly increase combat power.

6. WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

Add multiple weapon categories:

- Assault rifles.
- Submachine guns.
- Shotguns.
- Sniper rifles.
- Pistols.
- Light machine guns.
- Melee weapons.
- Grenades and other balanced tactical equipment.

Each weapon must have its own damage, range, recoil, accuracy, ammunition capacity, reload time, and firing behavior.

Add:

- Scopes and sights.
- Extended magazines.
- Weapon attachments.
- Body armor and helmets.
- Backpacks with limited inventory capacity.
- Ammunition.
- Health and recovery items.
- Weapon switching and pickup systems.

Create a realistic but accessible mobile shooting experience. Include hit detection, damage calculation, reload animations, sound effects, and server-validated combat.

7. MOBILE CONTROLS

Create smooth, responsive mobile controls with:

- A virtual joystick for movement.
- Camera movement by dragging.
- Aim and shoot buttons.
- Jump and crouch buttons.
- Sprint.
- Reload.
- Weapon switching.
- Inventory.
- Map.
- Interaction and pickup
"

## Objective
- Build "BATTLE WORLD: ELITE SURVIVAL", a playable original 3D mobile battle-royale game with Three.js, including lobby, character selection, island map, loot, weapons, bots, shrinking zone, touch/desktop controls, HUD, map, and match results.

## Requirements
- Android-focused, real-time 3D, optimized for low/mid/high-end devices.
- Original assets/brand only; no copyrighted Free Fire assets or branding.
- 50-player online BR when possible; configurable player count and smaller working matches are acceptable.
- Solo/duo/squad, optional practice vs bots, spectator mode, matchmaking and authoritative servers expected.
- Original island with city, military base, villages, forests, mountains, lake/river/bridge, industrial area, airport, harbor, bunkers, watchtowers.
- Player movement (run/walk/crouch/jump/swim), vehicles, minimap/full map/compass/zone boundaries.
- Character customization, progression, cosmetics, original characters and animations.
- Multiple weapon classes, attachments, armor, helmets, backpacks, ammo, meds, pickup/switch/combat systems.
- Mobile virtual joystick, drag camera, fire/aim/jump/crouch/sprint/reload/switch/inventory/map/interact, customizable layout.
- Build/export instructions for an installable Android APK if possible.
- Do not pretend unfinished features are complete; stage work honestly.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a static Three.js web game served from the repo; no bundler, Three.js vendored locally.
- Current build is a local practice match with 29 AI bots (30 total), not real online multiplayer; UI labels it "LOCAL PRACTICE SERVER" / "BOT-ENABLED PRACTICE".
- Real multiplayer/dedicated server and APK packaging are not implemented.
- Duo/squad modes are only selectable UI states; no teammate AI/team combat yet.
- Character/game assets are procedural primitives and canvas textures.
- Visual direction: stylized sunset tropical island, orange/teal HUD, glass panels, large condensed display type.

## Work State
### Completed
- Repo scaffold, local Three.js vendor, bundled Barlow Condensed/Rajdhani fonts.
- Full landing/lobby with modes, operator selection, profile stats, settings/help overlays.
- Procedural island terrain, water/sky shaders, sunset lighting, fog, clouds, birds, roads, bridge, city, military base, village, airport, industrial area, harbor, bunker, mountain, vegetation, loot spots, ATVs.
- Third-person player controller, camera, animation, swimming, jumping, crouching, vehicles.
- Weapons/ammo/reload/armor/medkits/grenades, hitscan combat, effects, audio synthesis.
- 29-bot AI with patrol/engage/zone behavior, health bars, kill feed, remote kills.
- Zone shrink phases, damage, zone wall visuals, minimap/full map/compass.
- Loot pickup system, inventory panel, match results, spectator mode scaffolding.
- Local dev server running in tmux session `bw-dev` at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright works after `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; screenshots captured.
- Lobby screenshot is visually strong and game boots without JS errors (only favicon 404).
- Temporary Playwright test disabled shadows and confirmed state reaches `playing`.

### Active
- Performance optimization. Current render calls are high (`~1574` with shadows, `~1287` without) and SwiftShader frame rate is low, causing the 3.2s drop sequence to run in slow motion.
- During drop, camera/spawn currently intersects city buildings; spawn point is `(-25,-110)` and must move to open ground.
- Need to reduce draw calls (loot visibility, far bot visibility, road dashes, shadows) and revise drop timing/camera.
- Need to inspect post-landing gameplay screenshot and combat/interaction behavior.
- Need update lobby "50 OPERATORS" claim to actual 30, and verify HUD on mobile viewport.

### Blocked
- Real online multiplayer, authoritative servers, matchmaking, and APK export are not implemented; would require a backend/build setup.

## Next Move
1. Patch `world.js` to replace per-dash road meshes with an `InstancedMesh`; reduce city lamp sprite count if needed.
2. Hide loot groups beyond ~70m and start/reset them hidden; hide far bots/health bars beyond ~95–105m.
3. Move spawn point `spawnPoints[0]` to open ground such as `(-20,-92)` and face the city; keep drop camera clear of buildings.
4. Optimize/drop shadows (default medium could disable shadow maps or reduce casters/shadow resolution).
5. Make drop timing use real elapsed time or optimize to ≥20 FPS so gameplay is visible ~1s after Play.
6. Verify official capture behavior (`CAPTURE_URL` at 1440x900 and 390x844) and tune lobby/gameplay screenshots.
7. Test desktop controls (WASD, mouse, fire/reload/pickup), mobile controls, map, inventory, settings, vehicle, death/spectate/result.
8. Update README with honest scope, controls, run instructions, and Android APK roadmap/build guidance.
9. Fix `50 OPERATORS` copy to 30, then git status/diff and commit if appropriate.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete lobby, HUD, overlays, map, settings, result markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: Full visual system, responsive HUD/mobile controls, lobby styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: Core game loop, match lifecycle, input, shooting, zone, vehicles, results, spectator.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: Procedural island, POIs, roads, vegetation, loot spawns, vehicles, raycasts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: Third-person controller, camera, weapons, health, animation.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: Still default OMGithub content; needs game docs.

- LocalThree.js is at `vendor/three.module.min.js` + `vendor/three.core.min.js`; import map maps `"three"`.

"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT: WORLD-CLASS BATTLE ROYALE GAME

1. GAME TITLE

Create a professional 3D mobile battle royale game called BATTLE WORLD: ELITE SURVIVAL.

The game must be an original, high-quality, action-packed survival shooter inspired by the battle royale genre of games like Free Fire. Do not copy copyrighted game assets, maps, characters, or logos. Create original characters, weapons, environments, and branding.

2. PLATFORM AND GAME ENGINE

- Build the game primarily for Android mobile phones.
- Use a real-time 3D game engine.
- Optimize the graphics and performance for low-end, medium-range, and high-end Android devices.
- Provide touch controls and customizable button layouts.
- Create a working, playable game rather than just a visual demonstration.
- Include all necessary game files, scripts, scenes, assets, and configuration.
- Provide a method to build and export an installable Android APK.
- If you cannot create the entire game in one generation, build it in organized, working stages without pretending unfinished features are complete.

3. MAIN GAME MODE

Create an online multiplayer battle royale game.

- Support up to 50 real players per match when server capacity permits.
- If 50 players are not possible in the first version, make the player count configurable and start with a smaller working match.
- Players enter a large island and fight to survive.
- Players can explore, collect weapons, find ammunition, collect protective equipment, and use medical supplies.
- The playable zone gradually shrinks, forcing players toward the center.
- Players outside the safe zone receive damage.
- The last surviving player or team wins.
- Add solo, duo, and squad modes.
- Include an optional practice mode with computer-controlled enemies.
- Add a spectator mode for eliminated players where appropriate.
- Include a proper matchmaking system and dedicated authoritative servers for fair online play.

4. OPEN-WORLD MAP

Create a detailed, original 3D island with different locations, including:

- A modern city with tall buildings.
- Abandoned military bases.
- Villages and houses.
- Forests, hills, and mountains.
- Rivers, lakes, and bridges.
- An industrial area.
- An airport and hangars.
- A harbor and beach.
- Hidden loot locations.
- Underground bunkers.
- Watchtowers and sniper positions.

Allow players to run, walk, crouch, jump, climb where supported, swim where appropriate, and drive vehicles.

Add a minimap, a full map, a compass, and visible safe-zone boundaries.

5. CHARACTERS

Create a collection of original, high-quality 3D characters.

Include:

- Character selection.
- Different outfits and hairstyles.
- Character animations.
- Running, jumping, crouching, aiming, shooting, reloading, and victory animations.
- Character customization.
- Unlockable skins and cosmetic rewards.
- A player profile showing level, experience, victories, eliminations, and statistics.

Cosmetic items must not unfairly increase combat power.

6. WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

Add multiple weapon categories:

- Assault rifles.
- Submachine guns.
- Shotguns.
- Sniper rifles.
- Pistols.
- Light machine guns.
- Melee weapons.
- Grenades and other balanced tactical equipment.

Each weapon must have its own damage, range, recoil, accuracy, ammunition capacity, reload time, and firing behavior.

Add:

- Scopes and sights.
- Extended magazines.
- Weapon attachments.
- Body armor and helmets.
- Backpacks with limited inventory capacity.
- Ammunition.
- Health and recovery items.
- Weapon switching and pickup systems.

Create a realistic but accessible mobile shooting experience. Include hit detection, damage calculation, reload animations, sound effects, and server-validated combat.

7. MOBILE CONTROLS

Create smooth, responsive mobile controls with:

- A virtual joystick for movement.
- Camera movement by dragging.
- Aim and shoot buttons.
- Jump and crouch buttons.
- Sprint.
- Reload.
- Weapon switching.
- Inventory.
- Map.
- Interaction and pickup
"
